instructions_to_main_agent: ALWAYS include data-testid on every interactive button, modal, form input, navigation link, and stat card.
Use Lenis smooth scrolling by initializing lenis in main wrapper or index.js.
Maintain strict color rule: Primary dark navy (#0B192C), soft cyan accents (#0088B0), and teal (#0D9488) used ONLY in the logo and badge highlights.
Do NOT use raw HTML select or date input; use Shadcn Select and Shadcn Popover Calendar.
Ensure 57 treatments are structured in a searchable grid with full expandability.
Provide working appointment form with validation, success modal, and fallback to direct WhatsApp pre-filled text.
Place location Google Maps iframe embed for Electronic City Phase 2, Bengaluru with landmark guide.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_standard: Awwwards-level medical healthcare site. No generic centered blue boxes, no stock blue gradients. Use expansive typography, clean borders, precise optical padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rule: Use Plus Jakarta Sans with tight tracking on headings (-0.02em). Use Playfair Display for editorial implant section quote overlays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.button_styles: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with explicit hover contrast changes (hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
